title: dictionary-merge — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one case of the canonical 0x02 vault.dictionary inner payload merge in myne-core (merge_personal_dictionaries, myne-md/myne#640; sync-protocol.md §10.2.1 + protocol.md §9.13.2). Pure logic over decoded plaintexts, no keys and no AEAD. All three byte fields are CANONICAL encoded payloads (NFC + sorted + deduplicated word sets (case folding is the LOOKUP layer's job, never the codec), sorted clock map), so a port whose merge is right and whose encoder is not still fails. The single-sided decision is the same function the vault.prefs set fields use (prefs_merge::single_sided_clock_rule, myne-md/myne#613) rather than a second copy. The Rust reference implementation lives at core/src/plugins/sync/dictionary_payload.rs and protocol/src/dictionary_blob.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable case identifier, unique within the category; the name a failing runner reports.

case_kind.description: The single case kind this category carries. The runner asserts both argument orders, so commutativity is structural rather than a second case.
